method.ui: Production AccountAudioPanel + SettingsHost. Volume changes use Slider SetProgress semantics; noise uses the Switch click.
method.settingsPath: UI -> SharedPreferences.apply -> production Application listener -> CallEngine.configureDevices
method.media: Local ICE/DTLS/SRTP Opus between two native PeerConnections. Production CallEngine factory, microphone track, APM and gain. Separate receiving APM prevents synthetic loopback being mistaken for acoustic echo.
method.input: Synthetic 440 Hz tone and deterministic stationary noise overwrite every capture buffer. No microphone samples or audio recordings stored.
method.measurement: Decoded remote PCM RMS and ADM playback PCM RMS (before hardware/system output volume), not just parameter readback.
method.noise: Measured with production echo cancellation, AGC, high-pass filter and toggleable software NS. No processing options overridden by the test.
method.persistence: Two host am force-stop operations, three different process IDs, no app-data clearing between stages. Observe normal asynchronous disk write completion; never force commit/flush. Verify restored engine configuration and controls.
method.lifecycle: Microphone stop/start with restored volume and noise suppression; native owners checked null on call teardown.

checks.microphoneZero: Near-zero decoded PCM, zero playback PCM
checks.speakerZero: Zero playback PCM while received PCM remains present

reproduce.target: An owned disposable emulator only, started with -no-audio; install published APK and a matching-signature androidTest APK.
reproduce.betweenMethods: adb shell am force-stop com.meetspace.app (do not clear data)

limitations: No physical phone/tablet, hardware noise suppressor, Bluetooth/headset routing, real acoustic background or subjective voice-quality measurement.
No hosted MeetSpace conference / server signaling or network reconnect exercised by this local transport test.
Signal/ringtone volume persistence is checked; its acoustic output level is not measured.
Playback PCM measurement precedes Android system volume and physical loudspeaker; it is not a sound-pressure measurement.
result: PASS for tested software audio path and process-restart persistence; no production-code change required.
